claim: Not exhaustive, not measured as effective in this agent; original methods evaluated only as possible routes

cards.choose_when: Use when outcomes/acceptance are ambiguous across affected consumers
cards.avoid_when: Avoid presuming formal phases prove the requirement source
cards.independent_probe: Compare final user behavior to agreed examples and old API compatibility

cards.choose_when: Use when multiple causes or unknown reproduction exist
cards.avoid_when: Avoid blindly patching the stack-frame that emits the symptom
cards.independent_probe: Run counterexample on suspected upstream cause and real runtime path

cards.choose_when: Use for domain ownership, conflicting vocabulary and leaky boundaries
cards.avoid_when: Avoid applying microservice decomposition to small local refactors
cards.independent_probe: Map contexts/aggregates and exercise a changed business rule through dependent callers

cards.choose_when: Use for impactful decisions where rejected alternatives and migration matter
cards.avoid_when: Avoid ADRs for trivial single-line fixes
cards.independent_probe: Compare no-change, compatible extension and redesign using new requirement walkthrough

cards.choose_when: Use when dependency and quality constraints admit mechanical invariant checks
cards.avoid_when: Avoid treating passing structural fitness checks as final user success
cards.independent_probe: Break an invariant deliberately and verify fitness function actually detects it

cards.choose_when: Use for risky legacy replacement with coexisting callers and rollback
cards.avoid_when: Avoid creating two permanent active controllers for one state
cards.independent_probe: Execute old/new calls, staged migration, rollback and retirement

cards.choose_when: Use for action sequences, interruptions, retries and durable state transitions
cards.avoid_when: Avoid assuming random stateful tests prove real-world outcome
cards.independent_probe: Replay failing transition sequence against independent reference model

cards.choose_when: Use AGENTS.md to convey concise repo-bound behavior in compatible Codex hosts
cards.avoid_when: Avoid assuming repo AGENTS changes native ChatGPT custom instructions
cards.independent_probe: Inspect actual Codex instruction sources and task execution traces

cards.choose_when: Use scoped Skill trigger metadata and references for recurring work
cards.avoid_when: Avoid overloaded catchall descriptions, contradictory skill copies and policy bloat
cards.independent_probe: Measure trigger/nontrigger precision and output on held-out actual agent tasks

cards.choose_when: Use trace and independent outcome measures for multi-tool agent workflows
cards.avoid_when: Avoid accepting model/self-authored tests as independent business approval
cards.independent_probe: Grade full actual task trajectories on unseen scenarios and outside observer outcomes
